info.name: PBL6 Workbook API Verification (Local)
info.description: Live local API checks mapped to Test_Report_API_Postman.xlsx. Uses seeded synthetic data and the active OpenAPI v2.0.1 paths.

item.name: AUTH-01 Register a valid synthetic customer

exec: pm.test('Valid registration is accepted',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(202)); pm.test('Accepted operation response returned',()=>{const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('ACCEPTED')});

item.name: AUTH-05 Locate verification message in local Mailpit

exec: pm.test('Verification email was delivered to the registered test address',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const m=pm.response.json().messages.find(x=>x.To.some(y=>y.Address==='pbl6.postman.sync.01@example.test')&&x.Subject==='Verify your email');pm.expect(m,'verification mail').to.exist;pm.environment.set('verificationMessageId',m.ID)});

item.name: AUTH-05 Read verification code from Mailpit

exec: pm.test('Extract actual challenge and one-time code from delivered email',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const t=pm.response.json().Text;const id=t.match(/challengeId=([0-9a-f-]+)/i);const code=t.match(/code=([0-9]{6})/i);pm.expect(id).to.exist;pm.expect(code).to.exist;pm.environment.set('verificationChallengeId',id[1]);pm.environment.set('verificationCode',code[1])});

item.name: AUTH-05 Verify registered email with delivered code

exec: pm.test('Delivered verification challenge activates account and returns session',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.accessToken).to.be.a('string');pm.expect(b.refreshToken).to.be.a('string');pm.environment.set('registeredAccessToken',b.accessToken)});

exec: pm.test('Unauthenticated request rejected with 401',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(401)); pm.test('Authentication error code returned',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED')); pm.test('Correlation ID returned',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Correlation-Id')).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty);

exec: pm.test('Authenticated current-user profile returns 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); pm.test('Profile identifies the seed customer',()=>{const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.email).to.eql('seed.customer@example.test');pm.environment.set('profileFullName',b.fullName);pm.environment.set('profileVersion',b.rowVersion);console.log('PROFILE_STATE',JSON.stringify({fullName:b.fullName,rowVersion:b.rowVersion}))});

item.name: PRF-02 Update own full name temporarily

exec: pm.test('Profile name updates at expected version',()=>{console.log('UPDATE_RESPONSE',pm.response.text());pm.response.to.have.status(200);const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.fullName).to.eql('Postman Profile Temp');pm.environment.set('profileChangedVersion',b.rowVersion)});

item.name: CMN-03 Correlation ID with caller supplied value

exec: pm.test('Correlation ID returned in header and error/data envelope',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Correlation-Id')).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty});

item.name: SRCH-01 Public search for seeded sellable trip

exec: pm.test('Search returns 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); pm.test('Seed result is present and sellable',()=>{const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty;pm.expect(b.items[0].sellable).to.eql(true)});

item.name: SRCH-03 Search with no matching trips

exec: pm.test('No-result search returns 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); pm.test('No matching trip is returned',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().items).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty);

pm.test('Departure time range filters returned trips',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.every(x=>{const h=new Date(x.departureAt).getUTCHours();return h>=0&&h<=3})).to.eql(true)});

item.name: SRCH-07 First page of seeded trips
SRCH-07 Second page of seeded trips

exec: pm.test('Second page does not duplicate first page',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.page).to.eql(1);const prev=JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('firstPageIds'));pm.expect(b.items.some(x=>prev.includes(x.id))).to.eql(false);pm.expect(b.totalElements).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('firstPageTotal')))});
pm.test('SQL-like input is handled without server error or reflected query',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include("' OR 1=1--")});
pm.test('XSS-like input is handled without server error or reflected markup',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(pm.response.text().toLowerCase()).not.to.include('<script>')});

item.name: SRCH-08 Search size above contract limit

exec: pm.test('Trip detail returns 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); pm.test('Trip id matches requested seed',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql('01990a00-0000-7000-8000-000000000007'));

item.name: SRCH-11 Read seeded trip seat availability

exec: pm.test('Seat list returns 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); pm.test('Availability timestamp is present',()=>{const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.availabilityAsOf).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty;console.log('SEAT_BODY',JSON.stringify(b))});

pm.test('Authenticated bookings list returns 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); pm.test('Booking page shape returned',()=>{const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array');pm.expect(b).to.have.property('totalElements');pm.environment.set('seedBookingId',b.items[0].id);const payLater=b.items.find(x=>x.paymentChannel==='PAY_LATER'&&x.status==='CONFIRMED');if(payLater)pm.environment.set('payLaterBookingId',payLater.id);const pending=b.items.find(x=>x.paymentChannel==='PREPAID'&&x.status==='PENDING_PAYMENT');if(pending)pm.environment.set('pendingBookingId',pending.id)});

TKT-01 List own tickets and retain a real ticket id

exec: pm.test('Own ticket page returns 200',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array');const t=b.items.find(x=>x.status==='ISSUED'&&typeof x.qrPayload==='string'&&x.qrPayload.length>0);pm.expect(t,'issued ticket with QR').to.exist;pm.environment.set('seedTicketId',t.id)});

pm.test('Own ticket returns identifying fields and opaque QR',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('seedTicketId'));pm.expect(b.qrPayload).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty});

item.name: TKT-03 QR contains no clear customer PII

exec: pm.test('QR payload does not contain seed customer name/email/phone',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const q=pm.response.json().qrPayload;pm.expect(q).not.to.include('Seed Customer');pm.expect(q).not.to.include('seed.customer@example.test');pm.expect(q).not.to.include('+840000000001')});
